lines.en: Gigantic shadow glides through the deep

lines.zh: 巨大的身体在水中滑行
古老鱼鳞在水面轻轻摩擦
lines.en: Ancient scales scrape softly on water
My armored skull pushes the water aside.
One stroke of my fin carries me far.
I cruise close to the seafloor.
My tail swings slow and heavy.
I stir sand up from the bottom.
My shadow slides over the coral.

lines.zh: 深邃的海洋中静静漂浮
lines.en: Floats quietly in the deep ocean
Floats quietly, waiting for an opportunity
Mouth open, letting the current pass.
One snap to test my jaws.
My eyes follow the shifting light.
Feels the threat of the player

lines.zh: 我从水下抬头，骨板嘴张开了。
lines.en: I raise my head from the water; my plated jaw opens.

lines.zh: 观察着玩家的一举一动
盾皮鱼没有须，是颌骨裂了。
lines.en: A placoderm has no whiskers. My jaw is cracked.
Fin bone broken, hard to swim.

lines.zh: 巨大的鳞片磨擦着你的手臂
你感受到了它的凶猛气息
它的眼神中充满了饥饿
lines.en: Its eyes are full of hunger

lines.zh: 你看到它那锋利的牙齿
它那庞大的身躯令人敬畏
它的呼吸声如同远古低语
lines.en: Its breath is like an ancient whisper

lines.zh: 它的体侧闪烁着蓝色的光芒
lines.en: Blue light flickers across its sides

lines.zh: 它那巨大的尾巴摆动着
它的眼中闪烁着贪婪的光芒
它的皮肤上布满了坚硬的鳞片
lines.en: Its skin is covered in hard scales

lines.zh: 巨大的身体撞击着岩壁
lines.en: Its body collides with the rock

lines.zh: 它冲向你，激起阵阵水花
lines.en: It rushes at you, sending splashes everywhere

lines.zh: 它那庞大的身躯撞击着水面
lines.en: Its massive body crashes through the water

lines.zh: 它那坚硬的鳞片发出巨响
lines.en: Its hard scales produce a loud sound

lines.zh: 巨大的头颅撞击发出轰鸣
lines.en: Its massive head crashes with a boom

lines.zh: 它用身体撞击试图吓退你
lines.en: It uses its body to collide and scare you away

lines.zh: 它撞击水面发出巨大的声响
lines.en: It collides with the water, producing a loud sound

lines.zh: 它的巨大尾巴撞击水面
lines.en: Its massive tail collides with the water

lines.zh: 它那巨大的身躯撞击水面
lines.en: Its massive body collides with the water

lines.zh: 它用尾巴撞击水面激起浪花
lines.en: It uses its tail to collide with the water, sending waves

lines.zh: 它用低沉的声音呼唤伴侣
lines.en: It calls its mate with a low rumble

lines.zh: 它在水中游动寻找伴侣
lines.en: It swims through the water searching for a mate
It touches bodies with its mate

lines.zh: 它发出温柔的叫声吸引伴侣
lines.en: It makes a soft sound to attract its mate

lines.zh: 它用触须轻轻触碰对方
lines.en: It gently touches its mate with its tentacles

lines.zh: 它用声音交流寻找伴侣
lines.en: It uses sound to find its mate
It tries to attract a female mate

lines.zh: 它用动作表达对伴侣的爱慕
lines.en: It expresses love through its actions

lines.zh: 沉重的肉体下沉入水底。
lines.en: The heavy body sinks to the bottom.

lines.zh: 猎物的味道在水中弥漫。
lines.en: The scent of prey lingers in the water.

lines.zh: 血味散开，我一口咬住那团肉。
lines.en: The scent of blood spreads; I bite into the flesh.
I tear the prey with my sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 骨刃一合，泥里的肉就碎了
lines.en: My bone blades close and the flesh in the mud shreds.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，在我嘴里碎成渣。
lines.en: This bone crumbles to grit between my jaws.
Now is the time to feed.

lines.zh: 盾皮鱼的骨刃，切开了水。
lines.en: My placoderm bone blades cut the water.

lines.zh: 我的骨甲咬下去，壳都碎。
lines.en: My bone jaw bites and shell cracks.
There is blood in the water.

lines.zh: 水底的影子一晃，我调转方向。
lines.en: A shadow shifts below; I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 巨口一张，水就往我这边流。
lines.en: Mouth opens, and the water flows my way.

lines.zh: 甲壳鱼鳍切开水面，我绕着你转。
lines.en: My armored fin cuts the surface; I circle you.
Maintain the attack on the prey.
My head plate aims at its flank.
Hiding in the rocks will not help it.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，可这骨板比牙硬。
lines.en: I have no teeth, but these bone plates are harder.
One ram and the bone breaks.
My jaws close like a shear blade.
A new ruler spawns in the water!

lines.zh: 深渊中诞生了新的生物！
lines.en: A new creature spawns from the abyss!
A splash of light in the darkness!
A monstrous beast has arrived, prepare to fight!
A new creature joins the battle!
The deep water suddenly goes quiet.

lines.zh: 一个巨大的影子浮上来

lines.en: I appear from the dark of the trench.
Bubbles rise in strings to the surface.
Drowned too long, hard to breathe.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的甲，我还是要撞。
lines.en: The arrow grazed my armor, and I still ram.

lines.zh: 饿得骨板发沉，我撞不动石头了。
lines.en: Hunger weighs down my plates; I can't ram the rocks.
